candidates.text: In standard radiotelephony, what does an instruction to ACKNOWLEDGE request?
options: Confirm that the message was received and understood.
candidates.tr_text: Standart telsiz konuşmasında ACKNOWLEDGE talimatı ne ister?
candidates.explanation_tr: ACKNOWLEDGE, mesajın alınma ve anlaşılma teyidini ister. ROGER yalnız mesajın alındığını bildirir; WILCO mesajın anlaşıldığını ve talimata uyulacağını da bildirir.
candidates.explanation_en: ACKNOWLEDGE requests confirmation of receipt and understanding. ROGER reports receipt; WILCO additionally reports intended compliance.
candidates.distinctness_evidence: The bank tests ROGER/WILCO and readback, but not the different request ACKNOWLEDGE.

candidates.text: ATIS is unavailable. Which standard request asks for the aerodrome data needed before departure?

candidates.explanation_tr: INFORMATION, kalkış için pist, rüzgâr ve basınç gibi verileri ister. DEPARTURE INSTRUCTIONS ise kalkıştan sonraki talimatlar için farklı bir istektir.
candidates.explanation_en: INFORMATION requests departure aerodrome data such as runway, wind and pressure. DEPARTURE INSTRUCTIONS is a different request for instructions after departure.
candidates.distinctness_evidence: 16456/59006 test ATIS availability/service; neither asks for the no-ATIS request.

candidates.text: At a controlled aerodrome, what standard request asks ATC for taxi instructions before departure?

LINE UP, without first obtaining taxi instructions.

READY FOR TAKE-OFF; bunun taksiye de izin vermesi.

candidates.text: Under the current SERA channel-identification rule, how is VHF channel 118.150 transmitted?

ONE ONE EIGHT DECIMAL ONE FIVE.
ONE ONE EIGHT POINT ONE FIVE ZERO.
ONE HUNDRED EIGHTEEN DECIMAL ONE FIFTY.

ONE ONE EIGHT DECIMAL ONE FIVE.
ONE ONE EIGHT POINT ONE FIVE ZERO.

AFFIRM EIGHT POINT THREE THREE EXEMPTED, regardless of exemption status.
candidates.tr_text: ATC CONFIRM EIGHT POINT THREE THREE diyor. Telsiziniz 8,33 kHz kanal aralığını destekliyor. Bu yeteneği hangi cevap bildirir?

candidates.text: ATC uses RECLEARED while issuing a revised route. What is the relationship between the new and previous clearance?

Both routes remain available at the pilot’s choice.
The flight plan has automatically been cancelled.
The aircraft is authorised to take off without a separate clearance.
candidates.tr_text: ATC rota değişikliğinde RECLEARED diyor. Yeni ve önceki müsaade arasındaki ilişki nedir?
tr_options: Yeni müsaade, önceki müsaadenin değiştirilen kısmının yerine geçer.
Ayrı kalkış müsaadesi olmadan kalkış yapılabilir.
candidates.explanation_tr: RECLEARED yeni müsaadenin önceki ilgili kısmı geçersiz kıldığını bildirir. CANCEL ise müsaadeyi iptal eder; CORRECTION mesajdaki hatayı düzeltir.
candidates.explanation_en: RECLEARED makes the new clearance supersede the relevant earlier part. CANCEL annuls a clearance; CORRECTION corrects a transmission error.
candidates.distinctness_evidence: CANCEL91113 and CORRECTION16405 are different functions; revised-route supersession is absent.

candidates.text: A radio check returns READABILITY ONE. How intelligible is the transmission?

candidates.explanation_tr: Bir en düşük anlaşılabilirliktir. İki ara sıra anlaşılır, üç zorlukla anlaşılır, dört anlaşılır, beş mükemmel anlaşılır demektir.

candidates.distinctness_evidence: Bank tests levels2,3,4,5; level1 has a different answer and was missing.

candidates.text: After landing, the tower requests a report when the runway is vacated. When is RUNWAY VACATED accurate?

As soon as the nose passes the runway edge.
When only the cockpit crosses the holding-position marking.
As soon as the aircraft starts turning into a taxiway.

Uçak taksi yoluna dönmeye başlar başlamaz.

All aircraft anywhere in the flight information region.
candidates.tr_text: SERA’ya göre meydan trafiği (aerodrome traffic) neleri kapsar?

candidates.text: What does IMC identify, as distinct from IFR?

Gerçek havadan bağımsız aletli uçuş kurallarını.
Belirtilen minimumları karşılayan görerek meteorolojik koşulları.

candidates.distinctness_evidence: Existing14267 tests VMC. Below-minima IMC and its distinction from IFR change the answer.
